beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Van bo af sien jy hoofsaaklik die koppie se ronde opening.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Not a language fault: the lesson sentence now continues 'ronde opening met die handvatsel wat aan een kant uitsteek', so the protected entry, which ends in a full stop, no longer occurs word for word; 'hoofsaaklik' is still there, but a person may want the entry updated to the new sentence so the guard still matches it.
